note: Named carries for the fleet watertight gate (tools/watertight-carry.mjs, read by the watertight audit fleetPassDefault runs). Hand-edited. Each row is a hull that leaks past the 0.05 L gate with its shipped interior fills: leakL is its leak volume in litres at the measurement resolution (0.01 L), with the owner who clears it, the date it was carried and the cause. The gate passes a listed hull at exactly its leakL (229 ratchet: below fails until the row is lowered) and fails on any unlisted leak, any listed hull that measures more, and any listed hull that now holds water (delete its row). Lower or delete rows; never raise one to turn a red green. Seeded 2026-10-16 from the 32 hulls that leaked at the 226 freeze (57600d613) and read the same volumes at the final 226 gate (4edd0e686); coordinator ruling 2026-10-16 14:35: a named 226 carry, the first job of the 227 regen. Re-based 2026-10-20 on integ/229 93cfe22c21 from fleetPassDefault on item/tests-speed-229: 10 rows deleted (they hold water now), 3 lowered, 4 raised to their 229 measurement with the cause; 22 rows. 2026-10-20 (item/vehicles-watertight-230, on integ/229 b45ee84fca + main 7b5bfed48a): 19 rows deleted, every one measured WATERTIGHT at 0 L by tools/tank-watertight-check.mjs: nine closed by the 228 fills round that reached main (51480cb695: ajax, c1_ariete_proto_serie1, c2_ariete_proto, leo2a4_v, leo2a4m, m6_linebacker, strv121, type59, xk2_black_panther) and ten by this item's fills regen (--rounds=8 --min-fine=1: c1_ariete_preserie, carro45t, centurion5_2, leo2a2, leo2a4m_can, leo2a5, strv81, t90a_burlak_proto, type10_tk_x, type10b). The three rows left (t72b3m_hetman, t72b3m_hetman_ii, t72b3m_kunlun) belong to the sessions changing those hulls; their fills follow their turret geometry.
